title: g_tls_safe_mode process-global: no per-registration hash-disable control
description:
Scenario: A library that wraps crypto2dev calls wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(), which sets g_tls_safe_mode=1. This silently disables hardware hash for every wc_Sha* object in the process that uses WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID — including any the calling application created before the library ran. The application has no way to opt out short of registering a second devId.

The limitation is documented in the header, but the wording does not cover the cross-library case. A future integrator who links a TLS library alongside bulk-data crypto will get silent software hash fallback with no diagnostic and file a performance issue.

Maintenance consequence: Support ticket every time a user finds their SHA throughput is not coming from hardware despite hardware being available.

The header comment says 'IMPORTANT — process-wide side effect' but only discusses TLS CTX vs. bulk-data CTX, not inter-library sharing.
